name: TO-ROADS-the-key-unread
note: Every First-Person Travel pick is routed, the roads key never asked: the original straight journey Mac asked back is gone.

name: TO-ROADS-the-key-inverted
note: Off reads as on: the roads switched on walk straight through the forest - the report - and switched off follow them.

name: TO-ROADS-reads-first-person
note: The roads read another key - First-Person Travel itself: every first-person journey routed, the roads key inert.

name: TO-ROADS-classic-routed
note: The classic skin's pick is routed too - refused in the Overworld's words ('part of the enhanced interface'), no journey at all: Travel Options no longer exact there.

name: TO-ROADS-first-person-only
note: The Overworld's own journeys are no longer routed unless the first-person roads key is on: OW-ONLY's map pick becomes the mod's straight ground journey.

name: TO-ROADS-the-fork-asks-the-owner
note: The map's fork asks who owns the journey: with both switches on the pick is still the mod's straight journey - the report, unfixed.

name: TO-ROADS-refusal-teleports
note: A first-person route refused (no way by land) falls through to DFU's fast travel - a paid teleport past the route's own law (AUDIT OW3 J2's hole, reopened).

name: TO-ROADS-refusal-said-twice
note: A first-person coordinate pick the route refused (the peaks) is also told 'You cannot travel there now.' beside its own words.

name: TO-ROADS-view-rises-with-the-route
note: The Overworld rises over a first-person route the first frame nothing forbids it - no longer first person.

name: TO-ROADS-lowered-view-stops-the-route
note: The Overworld raised by hand over a first-person route and brought down stops the journey - First-Person Travel's own walks on.

name: TO-ROADS-the-route-held-at-x1
note: A first-person route crawls at walking pace, held for a view that never rises (AUDIT OW4 J5's hold is the Overworld's journey's alone).

name: TO-ROADS-default-on
note: On by default: First-Person Travel is no longer the original travel option Mac asked back ('Off by default').

name: TO-ROADS-off-the-tile
note: Declared but on no screen: a key nobody can turn (TORCH-BIND's lesson).

name: TO-ROADS-a-second-planner
old: return summary ? travelViewRouteTo(summary, { roads: tvMapForcesRoads() }) : false;
new: return summary ? travelOptions.beginTravelAlongRoute({ legs: routeLegs(planRoute(playerTravelPixel(), summary.pixel, { roads: terrainGen.roads()?.roads ?? null })?.pixels ?? []), summary, name: summary.name }, !!opts?.speedCautious) : false;
note: THE ONE CONSTRUCTION SEAM broken: the fork plans its own route - no join, no peaks' law, no sea, no party, no trip line - beside the Overworld's.

name: TO-ROADS-the-travel-options-guard
why: Belt and braces, tvOwnsJourneys' own term: every door that asks has met the mod first - beginAcceleratedTravel returns on !travelOptions, the map's walked trip needs the popup's playerControlled (false with the mod off: isPlayerControlledTravel has no settings), and the coordinates popup opens only while coordsAllowed (the mod on).

name: TO-ROADS-the-view-guard
why: Belt and braces, tvOwnsJourneys' own term: the view is built at the host's boot, before any map can open or a Resume be asked for, so no caller ever finds it missing.

name: TO-ROADS-free-wins-the-pick
old: return summary ? travelViewRouteTo(summary, { roads: tvMapForcesRoads() }) : false;
note: The map's first-person pick asks the Overworld's Path switch: on Free, "First Person Travel Follows Roads" walks across country.

name: TO-ROADS-free-wins-the-spot
note: A first-person spot pick follows the Path switch: on Free it is pulled taut across country.

name: TO-ROADS-free-wins-the-resume
old: const roads = tvMapForcesRoads();   // TO-ROADS x OW-PATH
new: const roads = false;   // TO-ROADS x OW-PATH
note: The map's Resume of a first-person route re-plans it by the Path switch: on Free, across country.

name: TO-ROADS-the-route-ignores-roads
note: The place's route drops the forced roads: the first-person pick on Free never asks the road network.

name: TO-ROADS-the-walk-ignores-roads
note: The spot's walk drops the forced roads (a Free walk, the roads never asked).

name: TO-ROADS-a-forced-route-pulled-taut
note: A forced-roads route the roads do not help is pulled taut as a Free one is - not the Roads switch's law.

name: TO-ROADS-forced-for-the-overworld-too
note: The Overworld's own journeys are forced onto the roads too: its Path switch on Free no longer frees them.
